programs.title: American Titans
programs.desc: Rockefeller, Carnegie, Ford, Edison and Stanford - many of the organizations existing today bear the names of these famous Americans.They entered the lists of the most influential, talented and richest people due to their passions, inventions, achievements, and, rarely, by accident.They are treated by many as the founding fathers of the ranking of the 500 largest companies.Before they gained fame, each of them took great risks, thanks to which, after the period of the industrial revolution, they introduced America in the second half of the 19th century into the so-calledgilded age.
